t: Golf Driver Buying Guide: What Should You Look for?
s: September 21, 2025 - Find YOUR driver - There is so much advice out there about how to buy a driver. You might read that a short driver (44” or less) is the best, or just because you swing fast, you need an X-Stiff shaft. Although there is truth to these statements a percentage of the time, it all boils down to your preference. If you find a driver that has a penetrating ball flight and puts you in the fairway consistently, I don’t care what the flex of the shaft, or age of the club-head. Use it!
